form_plan.primary_theme_description: A tense Aeolian hook over a syncopated Am - Bb - F - E7 bass ostinato, coloured by the Neapolitan Bb and the raised leading tone G#, evoking a mysterious Eastern-bloc sci-fi comic soundtrack.

sections.description: Lead states the haunting A minor motif alone over bass and sparse noise pulse; channel 1 is deliberately silent to keep the texture hollow and tense.
Variation with a soft inner pad line entering underneath the melody; percussion doubles its hat pattern for forward motion.
Melody leaps an octave to the upper register over an Am - Bb - Dm - E7 harmonic twist, full drum drive.
Thinned-out breakdown: fragmentary lead echoes, half-note bass and a bare kick pulse; sustained dominant B in the lead hands over to the bridge.
Bridge in the subdominant region (Dm - Bb - Gm - A7); long suspended lead notes, pedal bass in half notes and a near-empty percussion channel create air and mystery.
Bridge builds: driving syncopated bass returns, eighth-note hats, rising lead sequence over the same chords.
Bridge peak with a Neapolitan Eb chord substituting for Gm; soaring lead in the top octave, full percussion, ending on a C# dominant third that pulls back to A minor.

intent.composition_notes: Four-voice POKEY arrangement in A aeolian with Phrygian/Neapolitan colour. Channel 0 carries the bright lead hook, channel 2 the syncopated 8-bit bass ostinato, channel 3 sparse noise percussion, and channel 1 a soft inner pad that is deliberately left silent in the opening statement and in the breakdown so the texture breathes. The A section runs Am - Bb - F - E7, the B section moves to Dm - Bb - Gm - A7 with a raised Neapolitan Eb at its peak. Contrast is achieved by density rather than volume: the bridge strips the bass to half notes and the drums to a bare pulse before rebuilding.
